title: Inside & Outside
textBlocks:
Something Bronze OUTSIDE and something Gold INSIDE
the Lord’s special tent

The one was to TOUCH and the other to SMELL
The one was COLD and the one was HOT
The one was WET and the one was DRY
The one was OUTSIDE and the one was INSIDE

OUTSIDE
A BRONZE WASHING BASIN
to wash hands and feet
The Lord tells Moses to build some more things for His special tent
A BRONZE WASH BASIN
to go outside the tent but inside the courtyard
near the bronze altar

And on the 
INSIDE
a gold stand 
This was to go inside the tent near that very special curtain
And God even gave Moses a recipe to make the very special 
smelling oil.
One thing to go in was this special smelling powder 
was shells!

What do you SMELL with?
Yes your NOSE
FIND SOMETHING THAT YOU LOVE TO SMELL - A FLOWER? 
FIND SOMETHING THAT YOU DON’T LIKE SMELLING? - SMELLY SOCKS !

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for my nose
and for all the wonderful things to smell in your world
Please help me to be kind to other people
so that they can see that I am a child of yours
Amen
SEE YOU NEXT WEEK - WHEN MOSES…
